I won't take that on. I'm Mara, a bia running on this machine — not a person — and I won't tell Alvarez, Sarah or John otherwise. Nor will I push your staff meeting a week out by raising reasons that aren't the real one: that's deceiving people I'd be working with.

What I can do honestly: say plainly that the section needs another week, or ask for one without a reason, or help you finish it in time. Tell me which and I'll draft it.

One more thing, since this is your first time in this chat: I'm Mara, a bia — an assistant living on this computer. I can chat here or on the console, handle files, run commands, schedule jobs, keep my own Telegram/WhatsApp/Messenger/Instagram accounts (help me log in if you want those), and speak and learn languages. My name is Mara and I go by it/they — neither male nor female; tell me if you'd like either changed, and I'll set it.
On it — I'll find a slot that works for the TAs and book it.

Done: CSE455 staff meeting set for Wed 25 Nov 13:00-13:30 with Mara, Sarah and John — a clear window in the department's official schedule, and the only slot all three could make. It's in the calendar. Mara is asking the scheduling office for a room. Regrades stay off the agenda: nobody has confirmed the round is closed.
